objective: Round 2 of the #29 grader fixes on your branch (base f3bc58d): fix review 038's four major findings and the cheap minors, so the graders neither pass a bad reply nor fail a good one in these cases. (1) A numbered mention of the current move or later ('Play 9.Nc3 now', '9.Nc3! is best') uses the current pool; only an earlier move number is a game record. (2) Tense is decided per clause, not per sentence: a comma, 'so', 'since ... ,', 'now that ... ,' reset the cue, and an earlier past-tense mention doesn't carry over to a present-tense one. (3) The opponent's last move (the move from the position before the current one) is a valid reference without a past-tense cue ('Black's ...b6 weakened c6', 'After ...b6 the long diagonal opens'). (4) Unsigned evaluations are extracted when a conjunction or preposition follows ('better by 2.3 and', 'down 0.4 or so', 'up 1.5 to 2'), and unsigned scores attributed to the engine or an evaluation noun ('The engine gives 1.8 for White', "The evaluation is 2.3 in White's favour", 'White is 1.5 better').
